newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Air Zimbabwe pilots strike for higher pay.
newsitem.headline: Air Zimbabwe pilots strike for higher pay.

text.p: Pilots at state-owned Air Zimbabwe went on strike on Friday to press for higher salaries, officials said.
Acting managing director Peter Chikumba told Reuters about 70 pilots had not reported for work, forcing the corporation to hire four aircraft and crew from other airlines for domestic flights.
"They have actually taken this strike action while we were in the process of negotiating salaries," he said.

Two private airlines have been established in the southern African state in the last two years and run regional and domestic services, which industry officials say will reduce the impact of a strike at Air Zimbabwe on the country's vital tourism sector.
